title: Work tape reads in an evaluation configuration
statement: Let $x$ be a bit string, let $B$ be a four-tape configuration on input $x$, and choose a control state $q$, a bit string $T$, a table cursor $p\in\mathbb{Z}$, a state tape $\sigma\colon\mathbb{Z}\to\{0,1,\mathrm{blank}\}$, and a state cursor $s\in\mathbb{Z}$. In the evaluation configuration built from these data, the four symbols read by the work-tape heads are, in order, the symbol of the buffer tape storing $T$ at $p$, the symbol $\sigma(s)$, and the symbols read from the third and fourth work tapes of $B$.
hypotheses_covered: A bit string $x$ and a four-tape base configuration on $x$
A bit string $T$ and integer table cursor $p$
A state tape $\sigma\colon\mathbb{Z}\to\{0,1,\mathrm{blank}\}$ and integer cursor $s$
replaced:
Consider an interpreter evaluation configuration whose table tape is the
buffer tape of a bit string $T$ with cursor $p$, whose state tape is
$\sigma$ with cursor $s$, and whose remaining data come from a base
configuration.  The four symbols under its work heads are, in order: the
symbol of the buffer tape of $T$ at $p$, the state symbol $\sigma(s)$, and
the two symbols read by the base configuration on its third and fourth work
tapes.
